The '''Xiochi slaver gang''' was a group of [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] who operated in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It was single-handedly broken by the [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Odumin]] who worked for the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].
